title: The Border
timelinePosition: Story start. No prior chapter. Midday-to-afternoon patrol; the mage crossed the first ward ring before dawn.
openLocation: Southeastern Eversong Woods, on Farstrider patrol near the Amani frontier
transport: Thalassian horses for Sylvanas, Lor'themar, and the mounted patrol
immediateObjective: Finish the troll sweep, dodge the Convocation budget session, and stay outdoors one more day.
constraints: Limited third on Sylvanas only. Nothing she cannot see, hear, or infer.

Jaina is 'the mage', 'the human', or 'the prisoner' in Sylvanas's head for the whole chapter, including after Cyndia says the name in Beat 8. The name exists in Cyndia's dialogue only; Sylvanas's narration never switches to 'Jaina'.
Jaina does not speak on-page. No Jaina dialogue before the chapter boundary.
No trust, warmth, or partnership behavior between Sylvanas and Jaina.
The word 'plague' does not appear in any thought or speech. Leylines are an unverified claim relayed second-hand, not a known fact.
No physical manifestation of the magical danger on the page. Ward-stone malfunction is report, not demonstration.
No proof that this is more than a human trespass.
Silvermoon is never cut to. Convocation pressure is felt through Lor'themar and Sylvanas's avoidance.
Pre-undeath Sylvanas: dry, exact, tactical interior. No banshee theatrics, no confessional emotion-naming.
Scene 3 closes on the outline's locked demand; chapter 2 must not replay it.

The name 'Jaina Proudmoore' has to come from somewhere that is not Jaina talking. Cyndia's identification comes out of the impounded gear, worked out after the runner had left the post (so Beat 4's 'identity unknown' and Scene 3's 'no verified identity' both stay true). Sylvanas checks it against the Farstrider watch-file she already carries in her head. Which object in the gear gives it away is the writer's call.
Ward geography: the mage crossed the first ring and was taken at the second. Beat 4 (runner) and Beat 7 (Cyndia) must agree on this.

Ward-stone hum and pulse on the ride (Beats 3 and 6) is the normal living border grid, getting denser toward the Pass. It is not an anomaly and it is not a sign of the danger. The only sign that something is wrong with the stones is Cyndia's report in Beat 7.

povKnowsAtOpen: Routine Amani pressure exists on the southeastern frontier.
The ward network looks stable in every formal report.
The Farstriders keep files on powerful human mages near the border.
Jaina Proudmoore is one of the names worth watching.
povDoesNotKnowAtOpen: That a human mage has already crossed the ward boundary.
mustNotBeImpliedYet: Any trust between Sylvanas and Jaina.
Proof that this is more than a human trespass.
Real proof the magic warning is legitimate.
A physical manifestation of the magical danger.
castKnowsLeavingChapter: Jaina is in Farstrider custody and has to make her case directly to Sylvanas.
Sylvanas knows the prisoner is Jaina Proudmoore, Antonidas's apprentice, not a random trespasser.
The breach has turned from patrol annoyance into a serious interrogation.
Sylvanas does not know why Jaina is here, whether Antonidas knows, or whether the warning is true.

pov: She opens treating anything south of the wards as someone else's problem unless it touches her stones, roads, or riders.
She wants to finish the troll work, stay on her horse, and avoid the Convocation budget session.
The report of a human mage inside the wards turns an easy patrol day into her problem.
By the end, the border mess belongs to her, and the prisoner is waiting in her own holding space.

beats: Before Sylvanas sees her, Jaina is just the human mage who ruined an easy day.
Sylvanas expects a polished Kirin Tor problem: spy, diplomat, or both.
What she finds instead is a road-worn young mage who looks exhausted, furious, and very far from court.
Even then, Jaina is still only the mage, the human, or the prisoner inside Sylvanas's head.

team.label: Partnership
beats: There is no partnership here. One woman is in custody, and the other decides how hard the door stays shut.
Jaina shifts from paperwork headache to the one person Sylvanas has to hear out.
The chapter ends on their first hard face-to-face with no warmth and no softening.

castAndHandoffRules: Lor'themar Theron: present in Scenes 1 and 2. Exits north in Scene 2 to brief the Convocation.
Mounted patrol: present in Scenes 1 and 2. Leaves north with Lor'themar once the report lands.
Ranger Cyndia: enters in Scene 3 as the border-post officer. Remains active into Chapter 2.
Farstrider runner: Scene 2 only. Delivers the report, then rides back south with Sylvanas to the post.
Jaina Proudmoore: seen in Scene 3, but does not speak on-page in this chapter.
Next chapter starts: Chapter 2 opens at Cyndia's post on the interrogation beat. Lor'themar and the mounted patrol are already northbound; Sylvanas, Jaina, and Cyndia inherit the scene.

scene.title: The Messenger
scene.sceneFunction: Bad news from the border lands, forcing Sylvanas to split from Lor'themar.
scene.knowledgeAtSceneStart: As far as Sylvanas knows, this is just an annoying border day. The easy rhythm has just been cut in half by a hard rider.

beats.goal: Receive the runner's report and get what is actually going on at the post.
beats.conflict: The report is clipped, tired, and thin: nobody at the post knows the mage's name, sponsor, or whether the warning means anything.

outcome.summary: The easy day is gone: a human mage crossed the first ward ring before dawn, was caught studying the stones without credentials, and is claiming the leylines are wrong.

newOnPageInformation: A human mage crossed the first ward ring before dawn and was taken at the second.
She was caught studying the stones without credentials.
She claims the leylines are wrong (an unverified claim, not an established fact).
Scouts do not know her name, sponsor, or whether the warning is meaningful.
beats.transitionIntent: planted-question: the report leaves a prisoner at the post with nobody senior to judge her. Somebody has to ride south and somebody has to ride north, and Beat 5 is that call.
beats.plannerWarning: Starting position says Sylvanas is in the dark about 'anything about leyline corruption'. The runner's relayed claim that the leylines are 'wrong' must stay a bare, unverified assertion: no 'corruption', no 'plague', no interpretation.
beats.arcLanding: POV bullet 3 starts here. Jaina-through-POV bullet 1: the human mage who ruined an easy day.

beats.emotion: Irritation hardening into command; the loss of the day sits under it.
beats.dilemma: Hand the mage to someone else and ride north with the patrol, or take the prisoner herself and send Lor'themar into the politics she is dodging.
beats.decision: She sends Lor'themar and the patrol north to brief the Convocation and keeps the runner to ride south with her.
newOnPageInformation: Lor'themar takes the patrol north to handle the politicians.
An unauthorized human mage near the wards is too big to hand off.
stillUnknownAfterBeat: Whether this is a diplomatic failure, a Kirin Tor spy, or something worse.
beats.transitionIntent: sensory-carry: the empty place at her shoulder where Lor'themar rode comes south with her. Beat 6 has to register it.
beats.plannerWarning: Irony available: she sends Lor'themar into the Convocation she is dodging. Gap where Lor'themar would absorb her temper should be felt, not announced. Keep the 'no one to absorb her temper' as physical absence, no emotion-naming.
beats.arcLanding: POV bullet 3 (the problem becomes hers). Jaina-through-POV bullet 2: she is weighing spy, diplomat, or both.

beats.goal: Reach the border post at Thalassian Pass fast and demand Cyndia's report directly.
beats.conflict: A wrong-leylines claim fits no standard spy shape; the terrain itself shifts under her and the problem stays out of reach until she arrives.

outcome.summary: She makes the post quickly but arrives with a problem she cannot yet categorize.

newOnPageInformation: A mage talking about wrong leylines does not fit a standard spy box.
Sylvanas is now treating the matter as serious.
She does not yet know the intruder is Jaina Proudmoore; the name has not reached her.
Her working guess is a Kirin Tor spy, a diplomat, or both, and the leyline claim does not fit any of those.
stillUnknownAfterBeat: Whether the intruder is hostile, reckless, or in over her head.
sensoryAnchors: the empty riding position beside her; the runner falls in behind, not beside
beats.transitionIntent: action-continuation: the post comes into view and she goes straight to Cyndia. Scene 3 opens with her already demanding the account.
beats.plannerWarning: Outline says 'doesn't know she's riding to meet Jaina Proudmoore' yet her starting position includes Jaina on a watch list. Do not let her guess the name here; she does not know a mage is Jaina until Beat 8.
beats.arcLanding: Jaina-through-POV bullet 2 (she expects a polished Kirin Tor problem).
